title: Consumer Spending
headline_read: Consumers are still spending at a healthy pace.

indicators.title: Retail Sales · year-over-year
indicators.context: How fast retail and food-service sales are growing versus a year ago (nominal — inflation is part of the number). A stall here is how consumer recessions announce themselves.
indicators.read: Retail sales are up 5.0% from a year ago — a steady pace.

indicators.title: Real Consumer Spending · year-over-year
indicators.context: Total household consumption adjusted for inflation — the cleanest read on whether people are actually buying more, or just paying more.
indicators.read: Real consumer spending is up 2.1% from a year ago — a steady pace.

indicators.title: Vehicle Sales · annual rate
indicators.context: Light-vehicle sales in millions at an annual rate — the classic big-ticket purchase. Households delay new cars first when budgets tighten.
indicators.read: Vehicle sales are at 16.8 million a year — a healthy big-ticket pace.
